messages:
oliver_privacy: Quick triage: DSAR from EU customer requesting deletion. They supplied account_id + recent session token. They claim embeddings exist in both our managed vector DB (vec-global-13) and in nightly GCS backups encrypted with their CMK: projects/customer-558/locations/global/keyRings/blue/cryptoKeys/k1.

rachel_legal: Confirm identity is fine. Check for any active legal or compliance holds; none listed. Need to ensure we can provide proof-of-delete bundle if completed.

samir_sre: We do not have Decrypt permission on their CMK. Deleting objects by calling storage.objects.delete will remove GCS blobs, but if customer wants proof of decrypt+scrub of content we need access. Suggest ephemeral grant flow.

meera_engsec: To reduce customer friction, offer two choices in the portal: (A) customer grants a limited-time grant to our service account via their IAM console (we'll provide exact principal + recommended condition), or (B) customer triggers a rewrap: re-encrypt older snapshots with a key we can decrypt, then we perform scrub. Option B needs clear instructions and is more manual.

jo_platform: For RBAC we'll create roles/redwood.dsar_worker_v2 with minimal perms and IAM condition on dsar_id + timestamp. Example condition: request.resource == 'projects/customer-558/...' && request.auth.claims.dsar_id == 'dsar-2025-05-10-01' && request.time < timestamp('2025-05-11T00:00:00Z').

oliver_privacy: Also: check for transient snapshots (cold storage) and retained copies in backup GLACIER-like buckets — need to enumerate and include in deletion plan.

samir_sre: Note: vector DB uses chunked embedding storage. Deleting index entries means mark-as-deleted then compaction cycle removes actual vectors. We'll need to run compaction or trigger it. Add compaction job id to evidence bundle.

rachel_legal: Evidence bundle should include: list of object names, vector shard ids and compaction job ids, audit log slice with dsar_id and worker identity, and KMS access logs (showing any Decrypt or Denied attempts). Retain bundle for four years.

kms-bot: KMS access ticket created: KMS-TICKET-7782.

meera_engsec: Plan: meera -> IAM role PR + sample IAM condition by EOD, samir -> compaction + runbook, jo -> audit changes, oliver -> DSAR reply draft and evidence template. We'll pause on deletion until customer either grants the ephemeral IAM binding or performs rewrap.

oliver_privacy: I'll send the portal reply offering both flows and include exact principal string and minimal condition example.
